notes.title: ASTRALODE Freeminers v0.95 Patch Notes + OST Released!

notes.title: ASTRALODE Freeminers v0.94 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey there! It's been an [i]awfully[/i] long time since this thing's been updated. There are a number of tweaks and changes I've been sitting on for an eternity, some small, some pretty big. They go a little like:

[list]
[*]Ore upgrading is now significantly more forgiving! Bombs can be safely detonated directly on ore, making it far easier to pull off an upgrading explosion and much harder to make an ore-ruining mistake. Burnt ore is the exception, a direct hit with a bomb will still ruin the ore if it has already been overcooked.
[*]An indicator of ore harvest & mining progress in the current asteroid now appears in the main game window below the ship, rather than needing to be checked in the pause menu (but the detailed list of exactly which ore have been collected still resides there in the pause menu).
[*]The origin of the Lazer Boomer's 4-pane AOE is repositioned to more sensibly align with where the tool makes contact with the obstacle
[*]Visual effects for ore harvest and ore ruin are now fancier.
[*]Sound effects for ore harvest and losing a tool are slightly louder.
[*]Spacing in the dialogue box has been reworked to accommodate 4 lines of text, now making it possible for longer strings of text to fit into a single page.
[*]A number of minor bugs in the menu have been fixed, such as settings refusing to reset to the correct defaults, some inconsistencies in setting titles, and layering issues with various game elements active below the pause menu.
[*]A bug where the Trainer Gainer goal would refuse to unlock even after a copilot was sufficiently levelled up is now fixed.
[*]A bug where a useless and unintended 0 kB config file would be created in the root directory on game launch fixed.
[*]Various edits made to text and dialogue to accommodate the change in bomb/ore mechanics.
[/list]
Added later via quiet patch (Jul 8, 2022 @ 4:37pm)
[list]
[*]A bug where the pause menu would be buggy and unusable while either the Atlas Mineralis or Certification Guide subscreens were open fixed.
[*]A bugged and glitchy layout of the failure screen when too much ore has been ruined has been fixed, caused by the recently introduced ore harvest & mining progress on-screen indicator improperly disabling.
[*]Wonky text alignment of goal descriptions on the Certification Guide subscreen fixed.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37179176/b46d9cdde246ba9a972d55c36bc4794805a2780c.gif[/img]

Thanks to anyone who still gives a crap about ASTRALODE Freeminers! Be sure to report any bugs you find [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1273010/discussions/0/2523653167134915687/]on the Steam community forums over here[/url], and please share whatever suggestions or feedback you have :)

- Drixxel

notes.title: ASTRALODE Freeminers v0.92 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Here's another small patch of mostly minor fixes and tweaks:
[list]
[*]top-to-bottom (and vice-versa) looping added to navigation of the pause menu
[*]frequency of rare ore spawns increased
[*]an input bug where use of an XBOX controller (360 + XB1) would set the deadzone to a level that made it virtually impossible to detect analog movements fixed
[*]a display error with the in-game leaderboard where entries would spill over on the 2nd page fixed
[*]a bug where gameplay wouldn't properly pause while the Steam Overlay is active fixed
[*]a bug where laser tool power-up icons could stop animating after use of a Rock-A-Roller fixed
[*]a bug where the point-of-no-return red line would fail to appear when playing tutorial lessons 2 to 4 fixed
[*]a bug where the copilot dialogue for first harvest of an ore could be triggered by ruining an ore fixed
[/list]
Thanks for playing ASTRALODE Freeminers! Be sure to report any bugs you find on the forums over here (https://steamcommunity.com/app/1273010/discussions/0/2523653167134915687/), and please share whatever suggestions or feedback you have :)

notes.title: ASTRALODE Freeminers v0.91 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Just a quick patch here to tidy up a handful of things:
[list]
[*]menu transitions have been sped up
[*]floating text, such as during the tutorial, can now be skipped through quicker, so jamming the confirm button will speed through lines of text faster
[*]a bug where menu item descriptions in the pause menu could overlap fixed
[*]a bug where the task icon checkmarks at the certification guide subscreen would get glitched after the first viewing fixed
[*]tutorial lesson 4 - stage 3's layout has been edited slightly to better ensure a 10+ tool chain is unavoidable
[*]a number of small tweaks and fixes
[/list]
Thanks for playing ASTRALODE Freeminers! Be sure to report any bugs you find on the forums over here (https://steamcommunity.com/app/1273010/discussions/0/2523653167134915687/), and please share whatever suggestions or feedback you have :)

- Drixxel

notes.title: ASTRALODE Freeminers Released! (v0.90 patch notes + roadmap)
notes.content:
Alright, ASTRALODE Freeminers is live! Thanks for taking a look at this asteroid mining puzzle thing, hope you have a bit of fun harvesting ores and generally pummeling the heck out of wild space rocks :D

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37179176/37ea204638034780dc295d88e021f1caf4bac40b.gif[/img]

There are inevitably going to be a number of minor bugs and rough edges to smooth out which I'll be patching up as the week goes on, so please do report anything you find on the forums over here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1273010/discussions/0/2523653167134915687/.

As it stands right now, Freeminers is a stable and self-contained 1/3rd chunk of the full ASTRALODE, but launching as v0.90 leaves a bit of room to grow. Plus, there are a number of cool features in the pipeline for this standalone free version! :)

I've decided to add the rest of the Azimuth Starminers to the roster available in Freeminers, building onto the opening 3-piece of Griff, Lorelei and Tentax. Each of the locked copilots will require certain conditions to be met in order to be unlocked, which you'll be able to sleuth out by visiting the Mellodeck and chatting with the crew.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37179176/1f6e012bc623e184da9a1bde6373cb49988ac16b.gif[/img]

The Mellodeck is part of Azimuth HQ along with the Garage and Data-Dex, that whole wing of the main menu will become available in future updates. Your $core is being saved along with the rest of your player profile right now in Freeminers, though, so when the Garage is ready to be opened, you'll have cash to spend.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37179176/5725c34bf1ff4d50a2e080b5efe2f9761fb61a41.gif[/img]

Also, once I've gotten all of ASTRALODE full's achievements planned out, I'll be adding Steam achievements to Freeminers that sync up with everything involving arcade mode. Oh yeah, and the game's soundtrack will be available on the store here hopefully by the end of the week!

Anyhow, cheers for having a peek at ASTRALODE Freeminers! Thanks for playing, and feel free to join this freshly-created Discord if you're into it :) https://discord.gg/EQRNHsq

- Drixxel
